purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules differ from what production main deploys. 2.7.0 (main 5f22a328) deploys the R94-02 Rules; gameplay/r95 adds the R95-01 Ball Game draw 3 marker ('draw', six clubs per ball). Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

added: // R95-01 Ball Game: a draw 3 ledger (six clubs per ball) also carries 'draw', always the int 3, beside 'stops'. It is
// written at create and never added, dropped or changed later, so draw 1 and draw 2 ledgers keep their shapes.
hunks.why: R95-01 comment: says what the new optional ledger key 'draw' holds (always 3, beside 'stops') and that draw 1 and draw 2 ledgers keep their shapes.
R95-01: the ledger may carry 'draw' (allowed key only; its value and presence are checked at create and in the transition below).

added: // R95-01: 'draw' never appears, goes or changes after create (any draw present is 3; absent stays absent and 3
// stays 3). One form for every ledger: the R95-01 sweep measured it 3 expressions cheaper than testing 'in' twice.
hunks.why: R95-01: on every step after create 'draw' can never appear, go or change (any draw present is 3, and it equals the stored one); comment says why this form.
R95-01: at create (open) a ledger may carry 'draw' only as the int 3 and only beside 'stops' (draw 3 = six clubs per ball).
